what: Record of the one change to the vendored reference after kolibri1_tiny/ref.json was generated.
original_source_note: the byte-form of kolibri1_ref.py the numbers in kolibri1_tiny/ref.json were generated with (project commit 6787846a; header named the file 'R2' and cited project documents)
current_source_note: file identity of tools/kolibri1_reference/kolibri1_ref.py in this tree (also in PROVENANCE.json)
normalisation_procedure: parse both files with Python's ast module; delete the leading docstring of the module and of every function and class (replaced by pass if it was the only statement); compare ast.dump() of the two trees. Comments are not in the AST.
numerical_payload_definition: sha256 of json.dumps(sorted keys, compact separators) of kolibri1_tiny/ref.json without the keys oracle, r2_sha256, r2_provenance, reference_sha256, reference_provenance, generation_source_sha256, generation_provenance. Identical for the original ref.json and the current one.
statement: The numbers in kolibri1_tiny/ref.json were retained, not regenerated, with the edited source. Regenerating with tools/make_kolibri1_ref.py on a host with torch (pinned versions in PROVENANCE.json) would confirm them.
